ei.title: Algorithms as Architects of Our Digital Choices
ei.subject: 9월_2026 고2 모의고사
ei.lesson: Algorithms as Architects of Our Digital Choices

fullPassage: The concept of “choice architecture,” popularized in behavioral economics, highlights how the design of the environment in which choices are made can significantly influence the decisions people make. Algorithms are, in essence, sophisticated architects of our digital environments. By curating what we see, what we are recommended, and what options are presented to us, they subtly, and sometimes not so subtly, nudge us towards particular paths. While nudges can be used for beneficial purposes, such as encouraging healthier habits, they also carry the potential for manipulation, particularly when the underlying objectives of the architects are not aligned with the well-being or autonomy of the individual. The question then becomes: how can we cultivate and protect our human agency in an increasingly algorithmic world? It requires a conscious effort to maintain critical engagement with the technologies we use. It means actively seeking out diverse perspectives, following algorithmic recommendations, and making deliberate choices that go against the predicted grain. It involves cultivating a healthy skepticism towards the seemingly objective outputs of algorithms and remembering that these systems are designed by humans with specific goals, and that their data is a reflection of past realities, not necessarily a prescription for future flourishing.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① align → aligned: 앞의 be동사(are)와 함께 수동태를 만드는 과거분사가 와야 함
det.analysis:
✅ ① align → aligned — 'the underlying objectives ... are not ___ with the well-being'에서 objectives(목적)는 well-being(안녕)과 '부합되는' 대상이에요. 즉 objectives가 무언가에 '맞춰지는' 수동 관계라 be동사(are) 뒤에는 과거분사가 와야 해요. 그래서 aligned가 맞고, 동사원형 align은 틀려요 ←정답

❌ ② cultivate — 'how can we ___ and protect our human agency'에서 조동사 can 뒤에는 동사원형이 오므로 cultivate가 맞아요

❌ ③ conscious — 명사 effort(노력)를 앞에서 꾸미는 형용사 자리라 conscious가 맞아요

❌ ④ involves — 주어 It(그것, 단수)에 맞춰 3인칭 단수 동사 involves가 맞아요
det.tip: be동사(are) + 과거분사(aligned) = 수동태 '부합되다'

det.korean: ② follow → following: seeking, following, making이 and로 연결된 동명사 병렬구조

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

Algorithms are, in essence, sophisticated architects of our digital environments. By curating what we see, what we are recommended, and what options are presented to us, they subtly, and sometimes not so subtly, nudge us towards particular paths. While nudges can be used for beneficial purposes, such as encouraging healthier habits, they also carry the potential for manipulation, particularly when the underlying objectives of the architects are not aligned with the well-being or autonomy of the individual. The question then becomes: how can we cultivate and protect our human agency in an increasingly algorithmic world? It requires a conscious effort to maintain critical engagement with the technologies we use. It means actively seeking out diverse perspectives, following algorithmic recommendations, and making deliberate choices that go against the predicted grain. It involves cultivating a healthy skepticism towards the seemingly objective outputs of algorithms and remembering that these systems are designed by humans with specific goals, and that their data is a reflection of past realities, not necessarily a prescription for future flourishing.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말과 일치하도록 [조건]의 단어를 모두 사용하여 영어로 쓰시오.

넛지는 유익한 목적을 위해 사용될 수 있다.

[조건] (1) be, beneficial, can, for, nudges, purposes, used를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 7단어 (영어로)

det.korean: nudges can be used for beneficial purposes — 넛지는 유익한 목적을 위해 사용될 수 있다
det.analysis:
① 주어 '넛지는'은 nudges예요.

② '사용될 수 있다'는 조동사 can 뒤에 수동태(be + 과거분사)를 붙여 'can be used'로 써요. can 뒤에는 동사원형이 오므로 be를 쓰고, used는 use의 과거분사예요.

③ '~을 위해'는 for로 연결해요.

④ 마지막에 '유익한 목적'은 beneficial purposes로 붙여요.

순서: nudges → can → be → used → for → beneficial → purposes (7단어)
det.tip: can be + 과거분사 = ~될 수 있다(조동사+수동태)
